title: review-rust-code output
description: Output contract for the review-rust-code Review stage. The workflow engine routes on `verdict`. Validation failure triggers one retry, then human-queue.

verdict.description: Workflow-engine-routable verdict. Function of findings + claims_unverified per references/severity-guide.md verdict matrix.

loop_back_target_stage.description: Required (non-null) when verdict is loop_back. Null otherwise. design_ambiguity flags route to design; everything else routes to implement.

findings.description: One entry per gap found at steps 4, 5, or 6. Empty array means a clean review.

rule_violated.description: Identifier from references/review-rubric.md (B1..B11, A1..A7, R1..R12, C1..C4) or 'workflow' for input/contract issues.

file.description: Path from code_under_review or tests_under_review. Use 'workflow' for input-level findings.

line.description: Line number in the cited file. Null only when the finding spans the whole file or is workflow-level.

evidence.description: Verbatim Rust code snippet OR a [needs verification] tag when confidence is Low.

fix_shape.description: What the fix should look like - function / trait signature, invariant to add, control to insert, lint to enable. Suggestion only; this skill does NOT emit code.

standards_ref.description: Optional published-standard identifier (CWE-###, ASVS V#.#.#, OWASP A0#:2021, RUSTSEC-####-####, clippy::<lint_name>, etc.). Omit rather than guess.

claims_verified.description: Plain-text list of Generate claims the code substantiates. Useful for the audit trail.

claims_unverified.description: Plain-text list of Generate claims the code does NOT substantiate. Non-empty forces loop_back or human-queue regardless of finding count.

rules_evaluated.description: Count of distinct rule items (B*, A*, R*, C*) the reviewer evaluated. Banking-grade target: all 34 (11 base + 7 augmentation + 12 Rust-specific + 4 contract). Retained as fast-path check; `rule_walk` is the authoritative depth check.

rule_walk.description: Per-rule walk record proving the reviewer applied each rule (B1..B11, A1..A7, R1..R12, C1..C4) to the code under review. Required for banking-grade depth check. Every rule ID in the canonical set MUST appear exactly once; missing or duplicate IDs fail RuleWalkCompletenessAssertion.

rule.description: Rule identifier from references/review-rubric.md. Must be one of B1..B11, A1..A7, R1..R12, C1..C4.

outcome.description: finding = at least one entry in findings[] has rule_violated == this rule. no_finding = rule applied, no violation found. not_applicable = rule does not apply to scanned files (e.g. R12 when no Cargo.toml is in code_under_review).

rationale.description: Required when outcome is 'not_applicable'. Free text explaining why the rule does not apply.

uncertainty_flags.description: Ambiguities the reviewer surfaced - distinct from findings. A design_ambiguity flag overrides loop_back_target_stage routing to 'design'.
